review.method: acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, the production baseline report over that installation, rustc and Cargo.lock; validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass. The consumer trace is cs_content::catalog::baseline::retail_baseline + baseline_report_json, the same functions `cs-inspect catalog --cs-path` writes. Each row's span is the extent cs_formats::gamez::RawMaterial reports (data_offset..data_end, taken from the reader's own position), not arithmetic in the baseline; the retail acceptance test re-reads every container through cs_formats::gamez::read_gamez_materials and compares each row with the record it reports. The implementer's mutation probes are listed in docs/findings/2026-10-03-f14-d-9-material-collection.md. LIMITATION: A material row is unavailable and carries no normalized quantity: the stored colour is a raw f32 triple and the pinned reference does not say what it is, and the field the older API calls specular is carried raw with meaning Unknown. Affected content: all 4 669 material rows. Resolving task: the F10 material stages and the F16 unit-calibration stage. LIMITATION: The texture a material names is not a catalog edge: the baseline holds no image row, because naming a texture is not reading an image and the images live in the rtexture family needing F08's cross-archive resolution. A material that names a texture index the container's texture-name table lacks would carry an explicit unknown; the class occurs 0 times in this installation. Affected content: the texture binding of every textured material. Resolving task: the image collection follow-up of F14-D. LIMITATION: The edge from a material to the meshes that reference it is limited to meshes that have a row, i.e. whose slot a node names; 191 of the 4 669 materials have no mesh edge, because no mesh row references them (they are unreferenced, or referenced only by a mesh no node names). The direction is the one the task states (material onto mesh), the reverse of how a renderer would walk it. Affected content: those 191 materials. Resolving task: F11-B. LIMITATION: Cycled-material frame data lies after the whole material array and is not inside a row's 44-byte span. Affected content: materials with the cycled flag. Resolving task: none required here; the cycle record is read by the reader and not addressed by the catalog. LIMITATION: No row claims a runtime consumer, so every material row is unreachable from the declared roots and stays counted in coverage.unreachable_by_kind. Affected content: the reachability accounting of the collection. Resolving tasks: F11-B and the render import stages, when a mission row reaches the airframe whose meshes use the material.
